scenarios.name: Child report deficit with later harvest
scenarios.trigger: A child completes with report-deficit while a later child has a harvestable PR.
scenarios.expected: report-deficit is preserved and harvest result is visible

scenarios.name: Release gate regression routing
scenarios.trigger: Inject a regression verdict into the release gate node.
scenarios.expected: failure follows the configured repair/review route, not publish

scenarios.name: Review cap and no-verdict boundary
scenarios.trigger: Stored review count reaches the cap or a review result is absent.
scenarios.expected: the cap blocks another request and missing verdict stays unmeasured

scenarios.name: Pod credential failure
scenarios.trigger: Remove the child credential or inject a Codex 401/503 response.
scenarios.expected: credential absence and temporary provider unavailability remain distinguishable

scenarios.name: TUI and gate worker stall
scenarios.trigger: Delay the UI event loop or stop gate shard output.
scenarios.expected: stall is named and unrelated work can finish

scenarios.name: Landing train rejection
scenarios.trigger: Inject a full queue, failed gate, conflicting head or closed cut window.
scenarios.expected: the queue refuses with a reason and does not grant a slot

scenarios.name: Pod pool capacity and query errors
scenarios.trigger: Omit a pool limit, saturate members, or inject a kubectl query failure.
scenarios.expected: known running counts are capped; a query failure preserves unknown occupancy and emits no concurrency recommendation

scenarios.name: Delayed dashboard turn throw and queue teardown
scenarios.trigger: Configure a turn:<stage> throw with an optional delay while one external input is queued.
scenarios.expected: the production plain-turn catch logs the configured stage, teardown restores idle, and the queued input is delivered once

scenarios.name: Draft triage 200-case safety inventory
scenarios.trigger: Evaluate deterministic twin, duplicate, harvest, landed-file, protected-label, running, and stale draft cases.
scenarios.expected: scenario completes PASS with the intended case distribution, no mismatches, and no protected/running draft closed

scenarios.name: Codex request-shape 400 recovery boundary
scenarios.trigger: Run the test-universe ScenarioV0 fixture with two injected HTTP 400 responses for the Codex request-shape boundary.
observe: ScenarioV0 completion event and runId evidence artifact
scenarios.expected: The isolated scenario records one request-rejected-shape event and one runId-scoped completion row.
